thread:
Ava (DevEx): Hi team — I'm opening my first PR but want to make sure I follow our conventions. Quick q: branch naming, squash vs merge, and any hidden lint rules?
Rajat: welcome! branch pattern is `feat/<ticket>-short-desc` or `fix/<ticket>-short-desc`. For hotfixes use `hotfix/...`. Keep it short and hyphenated.
Priya: +1. Also prefix WIP with `draft/` when not ready. We usually require a Jira ticket ID in the branch name (e.g., `feat/RED-1234-add-cache`).
Ava (DevEx): thanks! PR template asks for "what changed" and "how to test" — anything else reviewers expect?
Devon: include perf/latency impact if touching runtime paths, and list required manual steps if any infra changes. Small PRs = faster reviews.
Rajat: Our review process: 2 approvals for core packages, 1 for docs/UX. Tag relevant owners with @channel-owners. Use the "needs-review" label when ready.
Ava (DevEx): who are the owners for the runtime code? I'm touching `serving/runtime` imports.
Priya: ping @Rajat and @Devon. They own serving runtime. Also add label `needs-sandbox` if it requires dedicated infra to test.
Ava (DevEx): CI is failing on lint — `eslint` errors. Any local commands to run before pushing?
Devon: run `yarn lint` and `yarn test:unit` locally. For python infra stuff: `make lint` and `make test`.
Devon: example:
```
# javascript
yarn install
yarn lint --fix
yarn test:unit --watchAll=false
```
Priya: We also have a pre-commit hook via `husky` — if it's not running, run `npx husky install`.
CI Bot: Build #4521 · PR 17 · lint failed — see https://ci.internal.redwood/4521
Ava (DevEx): ah ok that explains it. One more: we usually squash on merge, right?
Rajat: We prefer squash merges for feature branches to keep main history clean. For bigger, multi-commit design changes we allow merge commits with a clear changelog entry.
Priya: add a short changelog blurb in the PR body when not just a small tweak.
Ava (DevEx): thanks everyone — I fixed lint, pushed a new commit, requested reviews from @Rajat and @Devon. Marking as draft until tests pass :thumbsup:
Devon: looks good. Happy first PR! we'll review after CI green :rocket:
